TRIP STYLE

Big-game & billfish

Plan a boat trip around large pelagic fish such as billfish or tuna. The target and local method define the tackle.

Find this style on the atlas ↗

Who it suits

Anglers who want a focused offshore trip and can meet its physical and time demands.

Boats & gear

Confirm the boat, tackle class, fish-handling plan and crew support. Do not buy specialist tackle before checking the charter’s provisions.

Seasons

Ask about the named target’s local window and current rules. The records below retain their own season evidence.
